services.name: School field trips
services.desc: Bring your class or group to the museum for hands-on time with real aircraft, guided by retired pilots and crew. The museum offers guided tours and field trips for school and youth groups, with hands-on time around historic aircraft. Tours feature aircraft like the UH-1 Huey and the Blue Angel F-4 cockpit, and include a roughly 30-minute hands-on tour of one of the museum's aircraft. Sessions are often booked by school groups, and content is tailored to the age of the students. Tell us your group size, age level, and preferred dates and we'll build your visit. services.name: Our Programs
services.desc: Hands-on STEM through the science of flight - real aircraft, real principles, and real career inspiration, tailored to your students. The STEM Learning Program connects Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math to real aircraft, the principles of flight, and the many careers aviation opens up. The museum helps schools meet their STEM goals with engaging, fact-based lessons on aeronautics and aircraft technology, including a roughly 30-minute hands-on tour of one of the museum's aircraft.
